title: The 63 | Fyfe Golf Event
description_plain: THE 63: Across the links of the Causeway Coast This October, The 63 brings Fyfe Golf and Top100GolfCourses.com to Northern Ireland for 63 holes across four courses in two days — a journey through Castlerock and Portstewart, and two very different days of links golf on the North Coast.
